description: My name is Dr. Kelly Henry and I am running for the Elmhurst D205 Board of Education. In addition to being a mother to twin second grade girls at Edi-Field Elementary, I am a part-time pediatrician and palliative care physician at Loyola University Medical Center. As a pediatrician, the physical and mental well-being of D205 students will be a top priority for me.
